paper.title_en: Where in the Island is the Information?
paper.abstract_en: The Island Formula for Quantum Extremal Surfaces of large AdS black holes, which are made to evaporate by coupling the CFT of the AdS/CFT correspondence to an external system, demonstrates that the space time picture can reproduce the quantum mechanically required Page curve of the CFT/bath system if a region in the interior of the black hole has become entangled with the external radiation by the Page time. In an effective quantum field theory (EFT) description in ``nice slice" coordinates, this appears to imply paradoxical entanglement between degrees of freedom that have been causally disconnected since long before the Page time. We will give two arguments that all of the quantum information in the island is in fact concentrated in a tiny space-like portion of the island very close to the black hole horizon at the Page time. The first applies the covariant entropy bound\cite{fsb} (CEB) to the causal diamonds of geodesics originating on the space-like region that becomes the island, but on a time slice just before the Page time. All points on the island except those in a stretched horizon region very close to the horizon have entropy bounds that are tiny fractions of the black hole entropy. The second argument uses standard quantum statistical mechanics combined with the tensor network renormalization group regularization of CFT to argue that the wave function of a typical pure state in the microcanonical evaporating black hole always has most of its probability concentrated in a small range of wavelengths corresponding to a small range of radii in the dual tensor network/AdS slice.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文直接探讨黑洞信息悖论与Island Formula的核心问题，理论深度高，提出了两条论证信息位于岛内靠近视界的狭窄区域，对黑洞热力学与量子引力基础有潜在重要价值，值得进一步阅读。
decision.abstract_zh: 大AdS黑洞的量子极端曲面的岛公式——通过将AdS/CFT对偶中的CFT与外部系统耦合使其蒸发——表明，如果黑洞内部的一个区域在Page时间之前已经与外部辐射纠缠，那么时空图像可以重现CFT/浴系统量子力学所要求的Page曲线。在“好切片”坐标下的有效量子场论（EFT）描述中，这似乎意味着在Page时间之前很久就已经因果断开的自由度之间存在悖论的纠缠。我们将给出两个论证，说明岛中的所有量子信息实际上都集中在Page时间时非常靠近黑洞视界的岛的一个微小类空间部分。第一个论证将协变熵界\cite{fsb}（CEB）应用于起源于将成为岛的类空区域上的测地线的因果菱形，但位于Page时间之前的一个时间切片上。岛上除非常靠近视界的拉伸视界区域内的点之外，所有点的熵界都只是黑洞熵的极小分数。第二个论证使用标准量子统计力学，结合CFT的张量网络重整化群正则化，论证微正则蒸发黑洞中典型纯态的波函数总是将其大部分概率集中在对应于对偶张量网络/AdS切片中一个小半径范围的小波长范围内。
